company.description:
Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in 42 countries, our employees serve clients worldwide—including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals.

As an Integrated Firm with scaled capabilities, we partner with clients at every stage of their financial journey. Our ability to do so is grounded in four pillars that define Morgan Stanley: a clear and consistent strategy to help clients raise, manage and allocate capital; a culture rooted in rigor, humility and partnership; financial strength through capital, earnings power and durability; and growth driven by smart, strategic investment globally.
 
These pillars enable us to provide trusted advice, operate with resilience across market cycles, and deliver long-term value for our clients and shareholders.
